coverage_note: Vanilla DayZ gameplay guidance only. The sickness icon does not name the illness, so use the symptoms and recent actions together. Mods and custom server medical systems can behave differently.

illnesses.name: Common cold
causes: Prolonged cold or wet exposure
Being close to an infected survivor
Sharing partly-consumed food, water or blood with an infected survivor
treatment: Get heat comfort to neutral (white) or warmer and keep it there
Use Multivitamin Pills or Tetracycline Pills
Keep food, water, blood and health high so the immune system can recover
prevention: Stay dry and warm
Avoid sharing partly consumed food and drink with sick survivors
Keep distance from sick players where possible
illnesses.notes: If it develops into coughing and fever, treat it as influenza rather than waiting.

illnesses.name: Influenza (flu)
causes: An untreated common cold while cold
treatment: Get warm and stay warm
Take Tetracycline Pills or Multivitamin Pills; take the next dose only after the current pill effect finishes if symptoms remain
Keep food, water, blood and health high
prevention: Treat a cold early
Stay dry and keep heat comfort neutral or warmer
illnesses.notes: Coughing can alert other survivors and infected. Codeine or morphine can suppress symptoms temporarily, but they do not cure the flu.

illnesses.name: Pneumonia
symptoms: Very high stamina drain / slow recovery
causes: Untreated influenza while cold
treatment: Take Tetracycline Pills immediately to push it back down to influenza
Stay warm and continue treating the remaining flu/cold stage
Stop risky travel and stabilise food, water, blood and health
prevention: Do not leave flu untreated
Stay warm while sick
illnesses.notes: This is a serious stage. Multivitamins, warmth and natural immunity alone do not cure pneumonia.

illnesses.name: Cholera
symptoms: Vomiting after eating or drinking too much
causes: Drinking from unsafe water
Drinking from an unpurified found bottle or canteen
Drinking or eating from a sick survivor's partly-consumed item
Drinking with bloody hands
treatment: Take Tetracycline Pills or Multivitamin Pills; do not stack the same medicine before its effect has ended
Take only tiny sips and bites, then wait, to avoid vomiting
Keep raising food, water, blood and health
prevention: Use pumps or springs where available
Purify non-pump water with Chlorine Tablets or by boiling
Wash bloody hands or wear gloves before drinking
Do not share partly-consumed food or water with sick survivors
illnesses.notes: The sickness icon can disappear before the infection is completely cleared; continue the treatment cycle if symptoms return.

illnesses.name: Salmonellosis
symptoms: Vomiting after eating or drinking too much
causes: Raw or rotten meat, fat or guts
Cooked wolf or bear steak
Eating or drinking with bloody hands
Food, water or blood from a sick survivor
treatment: Use Charcoal Tablets or Multivitamin Pills
Take small bites and sips only, with pauses between them
Raise food, water, blood and health
prevention: Cook meat and fat before eating
Wash bloody hands or wear gloves after skinning
Do not share food, drink or blood with sick survivors
illnesses.notes: It can look like cholera. Recent raw meat or bloody hands point more strongly toward salmonellosis.

illnesses.name: Food poisoning
causes: Gasoline
Burned or rotten food
Raw fish
Unknown food cans
Eating or drinking with bloody hands without gloves
treatment: Take Charcoal Tablets or let it clear naturally
Replace water and energy carefully with small sips and bites
Do not try to induce vomiting; that does not reduce the poisoning
prevention: Do not eat rotten or burned food, raw fish, or unknown food cans
Never drink gasoline
Wash hands or wear gloves before eating and drinking
illnesses.notes: Vomiting can also be caused by simply overeating; check what happened immediately beforehand.

illnesses.name: Wound infection
symptoms: Stage 1: pain sounds, light blurred vision and fatigue
Stage 2: heavier pain, frequent blur, fever, hand shaking and health loss
causes: Using a non-disinfected bandage, rags, bandana or sewing kit
Letting a bleed stop by itself
treatment: Stage 1: disinfect the wound with Disinfectant Spray, Iodine Tincture or Alcoholic Tincture; Tetracycline can also help
Stage 2: take Tetracycline Pills; disinfecting alone only slows progression
Keep water and health stable while treating
prevention: Check that the wound item says Disinfected before using it
Treat bleeding instead of waiting for it to stop by itself
Re-check a previously disinfected item after it becomes damaged
illnesses.notes: Do not wait for stage 2. Unlike many illnesses, natural immunity does not cure wound infection.

illnesses.name: Gas poisoning (PO-X)
causes: Entering a contaminated area without complete NBC protection and a working gas-mask filter
Exposure to PO-X gas from a vial or grenade
treatment: Leave the gas immediately
Use a PO-X Antidote
If an antidote is unavailable, clean blood from an unaffected survivor can be used through IV blood bags
prevention: Use a full NBC suit, gas mask and working filter before entering contaminated areas
Avoid PO-X clouds and damaged PO-X vials
illnesses.notes: Treat this as an emergency. Do not re-enter until the protective equipment is complete and the filter works.

illnesses.name: Heavy metal poisoning
causes: Consuming contaminated snow or non-chelated water on Sakhal
treatment: Use Chelating Tablets
Stop consuming the contaminated source and replace water safely
Treat it before advanced symptoms; time can help only before the severe stage
prevention: Use safe springs where possible
Treat water with Chelating Tablets or use a Filtering Bottle before drinking
Do not rely on snow as safe drinking water
illnesses.notes: This is Sakhal-specific vanilla survival guidance. It is distinct from cholera.

illnesses.name: Brain prion disease (Kuru)
causes: Eating human steak, guts or fat
treatment: There is no vanilla cure; the condition remains until the survivor respawns
prevention: Do not eat human remains

illnesses.name: Hemolytic reaction
causes: A blood transfusion from an incompatible blood type
treatment: Stop the cause and stabilise the survivor
There is no direct medicine; it clears over time only if the survivor survives the blood loss
prevention: Confirm compatible blood types before a transfusion
illnesses.notes: This is an injury response, not an illness to treat with tablets.
